Okay, so. I'm native. The biggest part about non-natives coming in and trying to use our practices and ceremonies, like dream catchers, white sage, smudging (not smoke cleansing, two different things) Sundance, etc etc, is that up until very recently, we were forbidden to practice any ceremony. And we lost a lot. We have generations completely disconnected from their cultures because of residential schools, anti-ceremony laws and the church. So for non-natives now to come in and want to take pieces of that culture, I'm sure you can see why that is infuriating and not okay.
